titles.title: [Order of Mass] Prayers of the Faithful Response

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Priest: Let us make our prayer to the God of our salvation because all our hope rests in him.

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: Response: Father, our trust is in you.

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Father, you established a covenant with men:
we trust in you, for you are faithful to your word.
Response: Father, our trust is in you.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Send workers into the harvest,
and bring the world to the knowledge and love of you.
Response: Father, our trust is in you.

verse.name: v4
v5
verse.lines:
Help men to create a community where justice and peace may flourish:
be with us lest we labour in vain.
Response: Father, our trust is in you.

verse.name: v6
v7
verse.lines:
We pray for our brother Matthew Tan. Lord, place in him a hopeful heart and strengthen his body as he recovers from his illness.
Response: Father, our trust is in you.
